## Deputies Elections

There have been 7 elections (4 contested) for Deputy held in St Saviour No 3 since 2002.

* * *

### 2002 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy (1 seats), 27th November 2002.

**[Roy Le Herissier](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/roy-le-herissier) was elected as Deputy of St Saviour No 3 in 2002**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Roy Le Herissier](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/roy-le-herissier)** |  | 500 | 82.4% |
| 2 | [Karen Stevens](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/karen-stevens) |  | 104 | 17.1% |

607 votes (inc. 3 spoilt papers)

1,822 registered voters

33.3% turnout
